Meaning – Definition – Objectives - Types – Nature – Scope – Importance of
Auditing – Limitations of Auditing – Difference between Accounting & Auditing

and credit sales, cash purchase and credit purchase

Companies – Audit of Insurance companies

Cost Audit – Tax Audit – Management Audit – Audit of Computerized Accounts
– Consideration of Audit in EDP Environment – Relevant Auditing and Assurance

            SEMESTER             VI

            COURSE TITLE         Auditing

            COURSE CODE       04BC0607

            COURSE CREDITS     04

            COURSE DURATION   48 Hrs (48 sessions of 60 minutes each)


  COURSE OUTCOMES:
         Trace the evolution, meaning, features, objectives, principal aspects, benefits and limitations
          of auditing.

        Company audit and its provisions, Content and format of Audit Report.

INSTITUTE       FACULTY OF SCIENCE
PROGRAM       BACHELOR OF SCIENCE (CHEMISTRY)
SEMESTER         3
COURSE TITLE   CAREER READINESS PROGRAMME
COURSE CODE     02CR0301
COURSE CREDITS  2


Course Outcomes: After completion of this course, student will be able to:
 1  Express ideas and information effectively.
 2  Deduce conclusions from various forms of data including text and speech.
 3  Choose appropriate alternatives in personal and professional life.
 4  Act in accordance with one’s own strength.


Pre-requisite of course:Before studying Career Readiness Program, all students are expected to
have basic understanding/knowledge of English language

Suggested Theory Distribution:
The suggested theory distribution as per Bloom’s taxonomy is as follows. This distribution
serves as guidelines for teachers and students to achieve effective teaching-learning process

                   Distribution of Theory for course delivery and evaluation

 Remember /   Understand     Apply       Analyze      Evaluate   Higher order
 Knowledge                                                         Thinking
    20.00         30.00         25.00         25.00         10.00          0.00

Instructional Method:
 1  The course delivery method will include interaction, class work, demonstration, role play,
     quiz and brain storming.
 2  The internal evaluation will be done based on continuous evaluation of students in the class
     -room.
 3  Practical/viva examination will be conducted at the end of semester for evaluation of
    performance of students.
